verdict.rationale: uv's documented public interface is its CLI: there is an official CLI reference, the commands are scriptable, and at least one command emits machine-readable output (`uv version --output-format json`). An agent can therefore drive it programmatically by shelling out. However, no programmatic API is evidenced: no library/SDK interface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic (library or HTTP) API, broad structured/JSON output across commands, independent evidence of agents driving uv this way.
